```lean
theorem lg_target {n a : ℕ} : (∃ x, x ^ n = a) ↔ n = 0 ∧ a = 1 ∨ n ≠ 0 ∧ n.nthRoot a ^ n = a := by
  split
  · intro h
    cases h with h1 h2
    · exact Or.inl (And.intro h1 h2)
    · rcases h2 with h3|h4
      · have h5 := h3
        have h6 := h4
        have h7 := pow_inj (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp h3) h5 h6
        exact Or.inr (And.intro h3 h7)
  · intro h
    cases h with h1 h2
    · exact ⟨1, by rw [h1, pow_zero]⟩
    · rcases h2 with h3|h4
      · have h5 := h3
        have h6 := h4
        have h7 := pow_inj (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp h3) h5 h6
        exact ⟨h7, h3⟩
```
